visual_review.notes: Reviewed every clip frame by frame. The ranged shot is retaken with steady light because the first take left a red glow on the ground after firing; it aims through frame 28, skips the muzzle flash and ground haze at 29-47, and snaps to the recoil squat at 48. The attack snaps from the drawn-back arm at 34 to full reach at 53, skipping the orange embers and dark plates at the impact; a retake asking for no embers exploded at contact instead. The walk loops two stomping cycles over 14-75. The idle keeps the breathing furnace glow from its prompt and skips five single dark plates. Hit, defend, cast and death are used as generated.
